These pages attach public evidence to names. **They are not biographies.** `page_status: draft` means the four-section role record is in place for Gate A; it does not mean a life history is finished.

Role statements appear only when a cited public source supports them:

1. Documented role (cited)
2. Attributed recollection / later organizational wording
3. Unresolved
4. Sources mentioning the person

Design-group membership is never inferred from later founder language or from Creekview participation.

Do not contact living participants unless a separately agreed research protocol exists. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/csil-history/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
